title: Agarose gel electrophoresis
summary: Separate DNA fragments by size for verification or extraction. The workhorse confirmation step for any nucleic-acid workflow.
hazardsMd: EtBr is mutagenic; wear gloves at all times. Designate one bench area for EtBr work to keep contamination contained.
contentUndergrad:
## How to pick percentage
0.7-1% for fragments >1 kb. 1.5-2% for <500 bp. Higher % gels resolve small fragments but slow large ones.

steps.title: Cast the gel
steps.instructionMd: Weigh agarose, add to TAE in an Erlenmeyer flask. Microwave 1-2 min, swirling every 30 s, until fully clear. Cool to ~60 °C, add EtBr to 0.5 μg/mL final, swirl, pour into a sealed gel tray with comb.
steps.safetyNotesMd: Hot agarose burns. Use heat-rated gloves and swirl with care.
steps.verificationMd: Gel is uniform, no bubbles trapped under the comb. Agarose has set firm (~20 min at room temp).

steps.title: Load samples
steps.instructionMd: Place gel in tank. Cover with running buffer (~3 mm above the gel). Mix sample with loading dye (5:1). Pipette into wells. Always include a ladder.
steps.verificationMd: Loading dye visible in every loaded well. Wells not overflowed. Ladder lane easily identified.

steps.title: Run electrophoresis
steps.instructionMd: Set 80-120 V, ~30-60 min. Watch the dye front: stop before the leading dye runs off the gel.
steps.safetyNotesMd: Lid must be on the tank — exposed buffer + power supply is a shock hazard.
steps.verificationMd: Bubbles rise from the electrodes. Dye front migrates ~2/3 the gel length.

steps.title: Image on gel doc
steps.instructionMd: Transfer gel to gel-imager tray (UV-safe). Capture EtBr image; tune exposure for sharp bands without saturation.
steps.verificationMd: Bands at expected sizes against ladder. Image saved as TIFF for analysis.

steps.title: Dispose of EtBr waste
steps.instructionMd: Gel goes into the EtBr-waste container. Buffer goes into the EtBr-buffer carboy. Wipe the gel tray + tank with EtBr-deactivating cleaner.
steps.verificationMd: EtBr waste container labeled and closed. Bench area free of stained drips (UV-check if unsure).
